item.title: Welcome to Paradise - Episode 26 October 2026
item.description: This episode covers major global and regional developments including the United Nations' concerns over Israel's displacement operations in Hebron, Brazil's historic presidential election comeback by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Serbia's political transformation with the Student List movement's election victory, the UK's ongoing challenges with homelessness, and the financial and operational insights from AI firm Anthropic's IPO filing.
